opinions.text: Sup. Ct. Mont. [Certiorari granted, 503 U. S. 905.] Motion of respondent for leave to proceed further herein in forma pauperis granted. Motion for appointment of counsel nunc pro tunc granted, and it is ordered that Billy B. Miller, Esq., of Great Falls, Mont., be appointed to serve as counsel for respondent in this case. Motion of petitioner to strike supplemental brief of respondent denied.
